messages:
ashley: Heads-up — found a case where embeddings pipeline leaks email-like tokens in vectors. PoC shows attacker recovering user@corp.com fragments from similarity queries. We should define a default transform policy for embeddings.

mike: yikes. do we have repro logs? is this specific to small models/quantization? :grimacing:

ashley: repro attached (redacted here). It's not quantization-specific — it's about high-similarity anchors. Proposal: per-route transform policy with a few levels: NONE, MASK, HASH, PSEUDO. Hash uses HMAC-SHA256 with per-tenant salt + rotation. audit logs keep hashed id only.

devon: can you paste the sample policy? want to see TTL + consent interaction.

ashley: sure:

```yaml
route: /v1/embeddings
transform:
  default: HASH
  fields:
    - name: email
      method: hmac
      algorithm: sha256
      rotate_every_days: 30
    - name: ssn
      method: mask
  audit:
    store_hashed: true
    retention_days: 90
    k_anonymity_target: 5
consent:
  require_token_for_unhash: true
``` 

lina: k_anonymity_target looks good but how do we calculate k across streaming batches? also retention 90d might be too long for some customers.

ryan: ops question — hashing every token for large payloads adds CPU. can we do sample-based transform for embeddings? e.g., reservoir sample 1% of tokens to hash for audit, rest hashed with cheaper fn.

sre-bot: alert: cost tradeoff: hmac per-field estimated +0.3ms/request @ p50 on 16-core. batching reduces overhead.

mike: idea: console UX to preview transform on a small sample — users can toggle a preview slider (0-100%) to simulate resulting vectors and audit counts. would help product & security signoff.

devon: we also need a canary mode where transform=MASK for a subset of tenants (by routing policy) so we can validate downstream quality impact without affecting all traffic.

ashley: agreed. pairing rollout plan:
  1) add `transform_preview` in console with sample size slider + example vector diffs
  2) add per-tenant `transform_policy` with canary flags
  3) implement HMAC salt rotation and audit-only hashed retention (no PII in plain logs)

lina: legal says any reversing risk is unacceptable for EU customers — we should add an option `disable_audit_hashing=true` that forces FULL_MASK for EU tenants.

ryan: how will consent tokens flow? if `require_token_for_unhash` is true, who stores token keys? KMS integration? key lookup latency concerns.

mike: KMS per-tenant keys with cached envelope decrypt should be fine. need guardrails for rotate_every_days.

devon: one edgecase — long contexts where PII appears only in prefixes. we should do prefix-preserving mask for n tokens to avoid embedding drift. i.e., mask first 256 chars if sensitive.

ashley: good call. add `prefix_mask_chars` per-route.

mike: TODOs: write RFC for transform policy + metrics we need in console (sampled preview diffs, audit-hash-count, cpu-ms-per-request), and a small canary plan. I'll volunteer to draft ops runbook.

lina: i'll draft legal config for EU/UK/regulatory customers.

ryan: i'll prototype preview slider in console mock and wire up a small sampled backend endpoint.

ashley: thanks. small ask: make sure preview is strictly sandboxed and does not persist any unhashed PII. preview must work on ephemeral samples only.

mike: noted. sync at 11:30 tomorrow? :calendar:

devon: +1

sre-bot: scheduled: infra-canary-window 2026-05-12T11:30:00Z (reminder will post in #eng-oncall).
